player_prompt.intro:
Mwauka kweni Frozen Lake!

Mwakudutsa 'P' pa gridi.
Mawonekedwe a gridi:
  ' ' = Thundu la mchere (kwambiri kukhala)
  'H' = Chilango (kukwata kuwononga!)
  'G' = Lengo (kukwata ili upeze!)
  'P' = Malo apongozo

Zithunzi zilizonse: ku pafupi, ku tsoka, kweni, kutsogolo (or w, a, s, d)
Tumiza chithunzi chocho as: [up], [down], [left], [right] or [w], [a], [s], [d]

Lengo: Kusogola ku mpando wa ku pafupi (pa mtundu) mpaka ku mpando wa ku tsoka (pa mtundu) pasina kuwononga ku masamba!

invalid_move.unknown_action: Ntchito yosadziwika '{action}'. Gwiritsani ntchito mmwamba, pansi, kumanzere, kumanja kapena w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Wakutumiza kuwonjezera {action} koma wakana ndi chipinda!

outcome.fell_in_hole: Inu anagwa mu dzenje! Game pa. Mwatha {pct}% ya ulendo kwa cholinga.
outcome.turn_limit: Mwafika pa malire a kutembenuka! Masewera atha. Mwatha {pct}% ya ulendo wopita ku cholingacho.
